question: Analyze the distribution of age-related CpG sites across chromosomes for both Zebra Finch (ZF) and Jackdaw (JD) datasets. Specifically, calculate the density of CpG sites per chromosome and determine if the distribution is uniform, which involves counting the number of CpG sites per chromosome, calculating the density, and performing a chi-square test to assess uniformity.

files.eval_guideline: Chi-square statistic must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error and degrees of freedom must match exactly; a reported p-value of 0 is acceptable when the true value falls below floating-point precision; column order and extra columns may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Exact basename and CSV format match; both correspond to the Jackdaw (JD) chromosome CpG density and uniformity analysis.
files.strategy_reasoning: The evaluation guideline requires matching aggregate chi-square results—statistic within 1% relative error, exact degrees of freedom, and an underflow-tolerant p-value—rather than record-level CpG rows. The CSV is therefore a statistical summary, making the summary strategy most appropriate.
